rule: Future endpoints are obligations, not fictional product connectors or suppressed opens. A full-board overlay routes only interfaces whose counterpart is in this milestone.

internal_required.name: BUCK_3V3_TO_MCU
internal_required.note: Inter-block supply routed in U3 within the target context.

internal_required.name: BUCK_GND_TO_MCU
internal_required.note: Inter-block return routed in U3; zone refill rechecked so a visually connected path cannot be electrically open.

internal_required.name: BUCK_VIN_15V
internal_required.note: Admitted external connection: actual counterpart (PS1 at ~104,125) is on the board.

internal_required.name: BUCK_EN
internal_required.note: P1 source-side tie only. Target U3 (SOT-23-6) exposes pads gnd/sw/+15V/fb/boot and has NO EN pad, so no board route exists or is required unless P1 source changes the package.

future_obligations.name: COMMS
future_obligations.note: Native net names. No IO38/IO39/TXD0/RXD0 nets exist on the target; U27 pads 31/32 carry i2c_sda_ui/i2c_scl_ui and pads 36/37 carry rx/tx.

future_obligations.name: SPARES
future_obligations.destination: unassigned MCU pads; future use only
future_obligations.note: Named so U2/U3 cannot mistake an unconnected pad for a missing connection. gpio18 is unconnected in source (P1 identity-inventory OBLIGATION-2); en/io0 are strapping nets shared with R71/R72/C41/SW1/SW2, not spares to reroute.
